meta.defaultTitle: Trafal — Publish your game. Get players.
meta.description: Trafal is the social network for people making video games: upload a browser game, show how you build it and get feedback from the community.

uploadErrors.NOT_A_ZIP: That file isn't a valid .zip. Compress your game's folder into a .zip and upload it again.
uploadErrors.CORRUPT_ARCHIVE: The .zip is damaged or incomplete. Compress your game again and retry.
uploadErrors.ZIP_TOO_LARGE: The .zip is too big: the maximum is {limit}. Try compressing images and audio, or remove what you don't use.
uploadErrors.UNCOMPRESSED_TOO_LARGE: Your game takes up too much space once unpacked: the maximum is {limit}. Remove unused files or shrink your assets.
uploadErrors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file “{path}” is too large: the maximum per file is {limit}.
uploadErrors.TOO_MANY_FILES: The .zip has too many files: the maximum is {limit}. Pack assets into atlases or remove the ones you don't use.
uploadErrors.UNSAFE_PATH: The file “{path}” has a name or path we can't accept. Rename it without backslashes, “..” or odd characters.
uploadErrors.PATH_TOO_LONG: The path of “{path}” is too long (maximum {limit} characters). Shorten your folder names.
uploadErrors.DUPLICATE_PATH: Two files have the same name, differing only in case or accents: “{path}”. Keep just one.
uploadErrors.PATH_CONFLICT: “{path}” is both a file and a folder. Rename one of them.
uploadErrors.ENCRYPTED_ENTRY: The .zip has password-protected files (“{path}”). Compress it again without a password.
uploadErrors.UNSUPPORTED_COMPRESSION: The .zip uses a compression method we don't support (“{path}”). Compress it again with the standard method (Deflate).
uploadErrors.OVERLAPPING_ENTRIES: The .zip has an invalid internal structure (“{path}”). Compress your game again with a common program.
uploadErrors.SYMLINK_NOT_ALLOWED: The .zip has a shortcut or symbolic link (“{path}”). Replace it with the real file.
uploadErrors.SPECIAL_FILE: The .zip has a special file that isn't a regular file (“{path}”). Remove it and compress again.
uploadErrors.EXECUTABLE_FILE: We don't accept executable programs (“{path}”). Trafal only hosts games that play in the browser.
uploadErrors.NESTED_ARCHIVE: We don't accept compressed archives inside the .zip (“{path}”). Unpack it and upload its files directly.
uploadErrors.EXTENSION_NOT_ALLOWED: We don't accept “{extension}” files (“{path}”). Remove it from the .zip or switch to a common web format.
uploadErrors.NO_INDEX_HTML: The file {file} is missing from the main folder. It's the one that opens your game in the browser: it must be at the root of the .zip.
uploadErrors.PROCESSING_FAILED: We couldn't review your game because of a problem on our side. Try uploading it again in a while.
